name: Ben Volavola
profileSummary: Ben Volavola is a Fijian Australian international rugby union player. He currently plays for the Queensland Reds in the Super Rugby Pacific competition. He has previously played for Leicester Tigers in England's Premiership Rugby, Agen in the French Pro D2 competition; for Bordeaux Bègles, Racing 92 and Perpignan in the Top 14; as well as Super Rugby clubs including the Waratahs, Crusaders, and the Rebels. Volavola typically plays as either a fly-half or full back.
